about: Device-chain verifier cases (engineering/devices.md in Canon). Entry bytes and the wire signature list are hex; expect.verify is Chain::verify, expect.prefix is Chain::verify_prefix. Codes and seqs are the contract; see the generator's module doc.

cases.name: genesis_device_only
cases.rule: seq 0 adds the first device, self-signed, generation 1

cases.name: genesis_with_kit
cases.rule: seq 0 may add the recovery device, which signs too

cases.name: empty
cases.rule: an empty list is refused

cases.name: genesis_not_self_signed
cases.rule: seq 0 must be signed by the device it adds

cases.name: genesis_kit_unsigned
cases.rule: the recovery device seq 0 adds signs it itself

cases.name: genesis_extra_signer
cases.rule: seq 0 has no signer beyond the devices it adds

cases.name: genesis_generation_2
cases.rule: seq 0 leaves generation 1

cases.name: genesis_kit_alone
cases.rule: seq 0 adds a device first

cases.name: genesis_second_device
cases.rule: seq 0's second subject is a recovery device

cases.name: genesis_prev
cases.rule: seq 0 names no previous entry

cases.name: genesis_seq
cases.rule: a list starts at seq 0

cases.name: trailing_bytes
cases.rule: an entry has no trailing bytes

cases.name: unknown_version
cases.rule: an entry's version is 1

cases.name: unknown_action
cases.rule: actions are 1–4

cases.name: name_bidi
cases.rule: names refuse control, bidirectional and invisible characters

cases.name: bad_signature
cases.rule: every signature verifies

cases.name: signature_list_mismatch
cases.rule: the signature list's ids are the signers the bytes name

cases.name: add_device
cases.rule: a listed device adds a device, generation unchanged

cases.name: remove_device
cases.rule: a removal rotates the generation by one

cases.name: signer_not_listed
cases.rule: the authorizer is a device on the list

cases.name: forged_signer
cases.rule: a listed device's id with another key's signature is refused

cases.name: two_authorizers
cases.rule: exactly one authorizer

cases.name: removed_signer
cases.rule: a removed device cannot sign

cases.name: readd_removed_keys
cases.rule: no key is added twice

cases.name: remove_recovery
cases.rule: the recovery device cannot be removed

cases.name: remove_recovery_disguised
cases.rule: the recovery device cannot be removed as a device either

cases.name: remove_mismatch
cases.rule: a removal names the device exactly as listed

cases.name: remove_unknown
cases.rule: a removal names a listed device

cases.name: add_recovery_kind
cases.rule: a recovery device is added only by rotate-recovery

cases.name: duplicate_name
cases.rule: no two listed devices share a name, ignoring case

cases.name: remove_generation_same
cases.rule: a removal must move the generation up by one

cases.name: remove_generation_skip
cases.rule: a removal must move the generation up by exactly one

cases.name: add_generation_moves
cases.rule: an add leaves the generation

cases.name: add_key_id_changes
cases.rule: every entry carries the current key id

cases.name: rotation_key_id_reused
cases.rule: a rotation takes a key id the list has not held

cases.name: batch_of_removals
cases.rule: N removals are N generations

cases.name: seq_gap
cases.rule: seq is one more than the previous entry's

cases.name: prev_mismatch
cases.rule: prev is the previous entry's hash

cases.name: pinned_same_head
cases.rule: a pinned device takes its own head

cases.name: pinned_longer
cases.rule: a pinned device takes a list that extends its pin

cases.name: pinned_older
cases.rule: a pinned device refuses a list shorter than its pin

cases.name: pinned_forked
cases.rule: a pinned device refuses a list with another entry at its pin

cases.name: backdated
cases.rule: a pinned device refuses a new entry dated before it last verified, less the skew

cases.name: rotate_by_kit
cases.rule: the recovery device replaces itself at once, rotating the key

cases.name: rotate_new_kit_unsigned
cases.rule: the new recovery device signs its own entry

cases.name: rotate_no_kit
cases.rule: with no recovery device a device makes one at once

cases.name: propose
cases.rule: a device-authorized rotation is pending; the old kit stays

cases.name: propose_rotating
cases.rule: a proposal leaves the generation

cases.name: propose_name_clash
cases.rule: a proposed kit may not take a listed device's name

cases.name: pending_second_proposal
cases.rule: one rotation is pending at a time

cases.name: pending_kit_has_no_rights
cases.rule: a proposed kit cannot sign

cases.name: pending_kit_unremovable
cases.rule: the old kit stays unremovable while a rotation is pending

cases.name: pending_kit_taken
cases.rule: an add may not take the pending kit's keys or name

cases.name: cancel_by_kit
cases.rule: the recovery device cancels a pending rotation

cases.name: cancel_by_device
cases.rule: only the recovery device cancels

cases.name: cancel_nothing_pending
cases.rule: a cancellation names the pending rotation

cases.name: remove_authorizer_voids
cases.rule: removing the proposer voids the rotation

cases.name: complete_early_pinned
cases.rule: a completion before the delay, by this device's clock, is refused; the prefix ends at the proposal

cases.name: complete_pinned_first_seen
cases.rule: a pinned device takes the completion seven days after it first saw the proposal

cases.name: complete_pinned_first_seen_early
cases.rule: and not a second sooner

cases.name: complete_reverify_past_pin
cases.rule: entries at or before the pin are not judged by the clock again

cases.name: complete_fresh_on_time
cases.rule: a fresh machine takes a completion the registry received after the delay

cases.name: complete_fresh_received_early
cases.rule: a fresh machine refuses a completion the registry received before the delay

cases.name: complete_fresh_not_due
cases.rule: a fresh machine refuses a completion before the delay by its own clock

cases.name: complete_fresh_missing_receipt
cases.rule: a fresh machine needs a receipt time for a proposal

cases.name: propose_backdated_pinned
cases.rule: a backdated proposal is refused on a pinned device

cases.name: propose_backdated_within_skew
cases.rule: within the skew it is pending from first sight
